project.name: plumb-dfa
project.description:
Unified DFA engine for the Plumb static analysis tool. Mirrors Fathom's 5-layer architecture (CallGraph / AnalysisEngine / FactKind+SinkFamilyRegistry / FunctionSummary / Z3 solver). All configuration externalized to YAML.
Owns every dataflow checker. R674 removed 9 dfa-unified checkers that duplicated plumb-style AST checkers (BigDecimalDoubleConstructor, FinalizeWithoutSuper, HardcodedCredential, InfiniteLoop, RedirectWithoutExit, ReturnFromFinally, StringEquality, SystemExit, ThreadRun). 71 checkers remain.
